business_summary: Leonardo is Italy's largest aerospace, defense and security prime (helicopters, aeronautics, electronics, cyber and space), listed on Euronext Milan. Its KRONOS AESA radar family and X-Gun kinetic effector give it two independent product lines addressing fixed and naval counter-drone requirements, alongside a much larger core business of record allied rearmament order intake.

exposure_summary.narrative: Leonardo carries three placements across two chains. On offshore-counter-drone: maritime-detection-radar (KRONOS AESA family, CROWDED, impact 70/crowdedness 62) and short-range-effectors (X-Gun kinetic effector, EMERGING, impact 62/crowdedness 55), the latter's sole citation flagged by the mapping's own changelog as not verbatim-supported on a live re-fetch, so treated here as INFERRED pending a corrected source. On munitions-replenishment: allied-rearmament-demand (OVER_CROWDED, impact 70/crowdedness 85), where Leonardo's own FY2025 results (23.8bn EUR new orders, +15% YoY; 19.5bn EUR revenue, +11% YoY) are the cited evidence and agree with this profile's own vendor-fetched revenue figure. No revenue is disclosed broken out for maritime radar or short-range-effector products specifically versus Leonardo's much larger consolidated defense-electronics and platforms business.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to the offshore-counter-drone exposure specifically (as distinct from Leonardo's group-level order book) is sourced for Leonardo this run. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 19,503,000,000 EUR from the yfinance-statements statements in LDO-MI.json; agrees with Leonardo's own FY2025 results press release (19.5bn EUR, +11% vs 2024) cited on the allied-rearmament-demand placement.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (19,503,000,000/14,713,000,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 1,710,000,000 EUR divided by revenue 19,503,000,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 1,750,000,000 EUR divided by net income 1,224,000,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 1,750,000,000 EUR less capex 1,016,000,000 EUR, divided by revenue 19,503,000,000 EUR, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 1,251,000,000 EUR (total debt 4,489,000,000 less cash 3,238,000,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 2,367,000,000 EUR (operating income 1,710,000,000 plus depreciation 657,000,000, period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 8 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in LDO-MI.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score PENDING_DATA in LDO-MI.json quality.beneish: missing sga_fy input (11 of 12 inputs found); not computable this run.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 31,760,776,724 EUR computed in LDO-MI.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 31,760,776,724 EUR divided by revenue 19,503,000,000 EUR for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 33,011,776,724 EUR implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 734,000,000 EUR, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon (5y 28.90%, 7y 21.58%, 10y 16.39%). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.

crowdedness_caveats: Leonardo's strongest offshore-counter-drone link (maritime-detection-radar, impact 70) is already CROWDED (crowdedness 62); its short-range-effectors placement scores lower on both axes (EMERGING, impact 62/crowdedness 55) and rests on a citation the mapping's own changelog flags as not verbatim-supported on a live re-fetch. The munitions-replenishment placement sits on an OVER_CROWDED link (crowdedness 85): the largest and most reliable revenue evidence here (record FY2025 order intake) is also the most discovered.
